I've searched extensively across the lease abstract document (covering Premises, Term, Rent Schedule, Renewal Options, Operating Expenses & Reimbursements, and Tenant Covenants sections) and found no mention of a right of first refusal or purchase option. The document appears to comprehensively cover the principal lease terms without any such provision.

**Answer:** No. Based on the Lease Abstract for Northgate Business Park, there is no mention of a right of first refusal (or any purchase option) to buy the property. The abstract details the Premises, Term (10-year initial term, April 2025–March 2035), Rent Schedule, Renewal Options (two 5-year options at 95% FMR), Operating Expense reimbursements (triple-net with a 5% cap), and Tenant Covenants (continuous-operation requirement) — but none of these sections, nor any other part of the abstract, references a right of first refusal or an option for the tenant to purchase the property. The tenant's rights are limited to renewal options; no purchase-related right is documented.
